species_family.asked: one bare species density family of at least five members
species_family.reading: not one wording: 8 members state ions summed over charge states with neutrals excluded, 5 mention neutral atoms without settling whether they are counted, 2 are silent on the population

argon_density.description: Charge-state-summed number density of argon ions, including Ar+ through Ar18+ and excluding neutral argon; local and averaged forms share this definition.

neon_density.description: Number density of neon impurity ions, summed over the included ionization states; line-averaged and volume-averaged forms express the same elemental content.

nitrogen_density.description: Number density of nitrogen ions at a plasma location, summed from singly ionized through fully stripped nitrogen and excluding neutral atoms.

oxygen_density.description: Total number density of oxygen atoms and ions across all charge states, from neutral to fully stripped, giving the local oxygen impurity concentration at a point in the plasma.

carbon_density.description: Carbon density is the local number density of elemental carbon in the plasma, summed over neutral carbon atoms and all ionic charge states through fully stripped C6+.

beryllium_density.description: Local number density of beryllium impurity ions per unit plasma volume, summed over all ionization states from singly ionized to fully stripped (Be1+ through Be4+), excluding neutral beryllium atoms.

boron_density.description: Elemental boron number density, summed over neutral atoms and all ionic charge states through fully stripped B5+.

tungsten_density.description: Number density of tungsten ions summed over all positive ionization states, excluding neutral tungsten, at a specified location or spatial average.

iron_density.description: Total number density of iron impurity ions in the plasma, summed over all ionization states from singly to fully ionized iron (atomic number Z = 26).

krypton_density.description: Number density of krypton ions at a point in the plasma, summed over all ionized charge states from Kr1+ through fully stripped Kr36+ and excluding neutral krypton atoms.

lithium_density.description: Number density of lithium impurity ions per unit plasma volume, summed over all ionization states from singly ionized to fully stripped, excluding neutral lithium atoms.

xenon_density.description: Number density of xenon ions at a given point in the plasma, summed over all ionization states from singly ionized through fully stripped xenon, excluding neutral xenon atoms.

deuterium_density.description: Deuterium density is the number density of ionized deuterium in the fuel-ion population. It is the local density of deuterons, excluding neutral atoms, molecules, and line- or volume-averaged deuterium densities.

tritium_density.description: Local number density of tritium ions in the plasma, the foundational fuel-ion parameter underlying chord-averaged, volume-averaged, and isotopic ratio child quantities.

hydrogen_density.description: Local number density of hydrogen (protium) ions in the plasma, giving the count of H+ particles per unit volume at a specified spatial position.

operator_family.asked: the flux-surface average applied to at least five names
operator_family.reading: 8 names carry 8 distinct operator sentences, matching the committed 8-form baseline for this operator
operator_family.settled_wording: the flux surface average is the average of a quantity over a closed magnetic flux surface weighted by the inverse magnitude of the poloidal flux gradient

flux_surface_averaged_magnetic_field_mag.operator_sentence: This quantity is the flux-surface average of the magnitude of the total equilibrium magnetic-field vector.
flux_surface_averaged_magnetic_field_mag.description: Flux-surface average of the local magnetic-field strength, retaining the pointwise modulus before averaging over each magnetic surface.

flux_surface_averaged_major_radius.operator_sentence: For this flux-surface-averaged quantity, that distance is averaged over each nested magnetic flux surface in the right-handed cylindrical $(R,\phi,Z)$ frame, wh
flux_surface_averaged_major_radius.description: Flux-surface-averaged nonnegative perpendicular distance from the toroidal symmetry axis to points on a nested magnetic flux surface, giving the mean major-radius coordinate in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

flux_surface_averaged_inverse_of_major_r.operator_sentence: This quantity is the geometric average of the reciprocal major radius over a complete magnetic flux surface.
flux_surface_averaged_inverse_of_major_r.description: Flux-surface average of reciprocal major radius, providing a geometric equilibrium coefficient for toroidal geometry in flux-coordinate equations.

flux_surface_averaged_inverse_of_square_.operator_sentence: This quantity is the flux-surface average of the reciprocal square of the major radius on a nested equilibrium magnetic flux surface.
flux_surface_averaged_inverse_of_square_.description: Flux-surface average of reciprocal squared major radius, providing a geometric metric coefficient for parallel-gradient and neoclassical transport calculations.

flux_surface_averaged_square_of_magnetic.operator_sentence: This quantity is the surface-averaged squared strength of the total magnetic field on a nested magnetic flux surface.
flux_surface_averaged_square_of_magnetic.description: Flux-surface average of the squared magnitude of the total equilibrium magnetic field, providing a geometric coefficient for equilibrium and neoclassical transport relations.

flux_surface_averaged_parallel_current_d.operator_sentence: Flux-surface-averaged parallel current density is the signed field-aligned contribution of the total plasma current density, averaged over a closed magnetic flu
flux_surface_averaged_parallel_current_d.description: Flux-surface-averaged parallel current density is the surface average of conventional current density dotted with the magnetic field, divided by a single global reference toroidal field.

flux_surface_averaged_effective_charge_a.operator_sentence: This quantity is the flux-surface average of the ion-mixture effective charge over the plasma boundary, identified with the last closed flux surface.
flux_surface_averaged_effective_charge_a.description: Flux-surface average of the ion-mixture effective charge over the entire plasma-boundary surface, distinct from the local boundary value.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_current_d.operator_sentence: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal current density is the signed geometric toroidal component of the net plasma current density, averaged over a closed magnetic flu
flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_current_d.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal current density is the net conventional toroidal charge flux per area, averaged over a closed magnetic surface with additional inverse-major-radius weighting.

accumulated_argon_count.description: Accumulated argon count is the cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of argon atoms delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown. Each argon atom contributes 18 equivalent electrons, equal to its atomic number; this is delivered inventory, not plasma electron content or ionization state.

accumulated_ammonia_count.description: Cumulative post-breakdown inventory of ammonia molecules introduced into the plasma vessel, expressed as an equivalent-electron count with ten count units assigned to each neutral NH3 molecule.

accumulated_carbon_count_due_to_gas_inje.description: Cumulative post-breakdown carbon inventory from gas injection, expressed as six equivalent-electron counts for every injected neutral carbon atom.

accumulated_ethane_count.description: Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of ethane molecules injected after plasma breakdown, assigning 18 equivalent-electron counts to each neutral C2H6 molecule.

accumulated_ethylene_count.description: Cumulative ethylene (C2H4) gas injection since plasma breakdown, expressed as an equivalent-electron count where each ethylene molecule contributes 16 equivalent electrons (2 carbon atoms at Z = 6 each, 4 hydrogen atoms at Z = 1 each).

co_passing_power_density.description: Flux-surface-averaged volumetric energy source rate for the co-passing orbit population, representing energy transfer to or from particles circulating in the co-current direction.

counter_passing_power_density.description: Flux-surface-averaged volumetric energy source rate for counter-passing particles, representing energy transfer to or from particles circulating opposite to the plasma-current direction.

counter_passing_fast_particle_density.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of suprathermal particles of a selected species whose untrapped guiding-center orbits circulate opposite to the plasma current.

ion_average_temperature_at_internal_tran.description: Kinetic temperature of the charged-ion population at an internal transport barrier, defined as the arithmetic mean of charged-ion species temperatures, excluding electrons and neutral species.

poloidal_ion_state_momentum.description: Area-normalized poloidal momentum source term for a single ion charge state, equal to force per unit area projected onto the local poloidal tangent. It is the charge-state-resolved contribution that sums to the total poloidal ion momentum source.

area_of_poloidal_field_coil.description: Non-negative full geometric area of the conducting cross section of one poloidal-field-coil element in a poloidal plane at fixed toroidal angle φ of the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, where R is major radius and Z is vertical height.

area_of_neutral_beam_injector.description: Area of a neutral beam injector is the source cross-section of the active ion-source emission face that forms the extracted beam before neutralization. For a multi-aperture source, it is the sum of the contributing aperture areas.

angle_of_antenna_strap.description: Second inclination angle (β) of the oblique trapezoidal cross-section of an ICRH antenna strap, giving the signed tilt of the beta-side lateral face relative to the directed strap base edge.

accumulated_lithium_count.description: Cumulative lithium delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown, expressed as an equivalent-electron count with three counts per lithium atom.

accumulated_hydrogen_prefill_count.description: Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of hydrogen atoms introduced by gas injection during prefill before plasma breakdown; hydrogen contributes one count per atom.

alfven_frequency.description: Alfvén frequency at a given radial position for a single toroidal mode number is the complex local shear-Alfvén continuum angular frequency; its real part gives oscillation and its imaginary part gives growth or damping for the stated time dependence.

conductivity.description: Local directional electrical conductivity coefficients relating conductive current-density components to corresponding electric-field components in a plasma.

density_at_magnetic_axis.description: Local particle concentration of a specified plasma population at the magnetic axis, with ion charge states aggregated and compound fuel mixtures treated as defined populations.

density_at_divertor_target.description: Local number density of a specified plasma species or species group immediately upstream of a divertor-target sheath, with ion charge states summed and neutral populations excluded unless explicitly named.

decay_length_over_scrape_off_layer.description: Characteristic outward distance over which a decaying plasma quantity decreases by one e-folding in the scrape-off layer.
